quotes.text: // The updates panel is disabled in MSIX builds.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Bug 1901962 needed a followup for MSIX builds. Current testUpdateHistoryDialog skips Windows when hasWinPackageId because the updates panel is disabled there. A platform alone does not identify that package capability. Keep the source reason next to the skip; no MSIX test run was performed.
title: Keep package-dependent skips tied to the actual unavailable UI
